summary: APi Group Corp filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its credit agreement and a notes offering. The credit amendment increased revolving commitments from $750M to $1.0B, extended the revolving facility maturity to May 2031 and the term loan to May 2033, and raised the letter-of-credit sublimit to $300M. Obligations remain guaranteed and secured. A notes offering was concurrently completed. These are routine debt financing activities, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other event-driven corporate action is present.
